userdoc.notice: OCC stands for "On-Chain Credit".          A "Bullet" loan is an interest-only loan, with principal repaid in full at the end.          An "Amortization" loan is a principal and interest loan, with consistent payments until fully "Repaid".          This locker is responsible for handling accounting of loans.          This locker is responsible for handling payments and distribution of payments.          This locker is responsible for handling defaults and liquidations (if needed).
